title: two cyclic tasks with different intervals load in simulation and each runs at its own interval
note: CMP-047 and RT-015: each task of zplc.json runs its programs at its own interval, in simulation as on a target; the native runtime refuses a task table whose tasks have different intervals, so CMP-051 also fails; in 40 ms (scans at 0, 10, 20 and 30 ms) a 10 ms task runs four times and a 20 ms task twice, at 0 and 20 ms
